bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education; requiring schools to implement a wearable panic alert system; appropriating money; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 121A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.

[121A.09] PANIC ALERT SYSTEMS.

Subdivision 1.

Citation.

This section may be cited as "Alyssa's Law."

Subd. 2.

Definitions.

(a) For purposes of this section, the following terms have the meanings given.

(b) "School" means an independent or special school district, a charter school organized in chapter 124E, or a nonpublic school as defined in section 123B.41, subdivision 9.

(c) "School facility" means a school building where student instruction takes place and includes all locations where students and staff are present during the school day.

Subd. 3.

Panic alert system.

(a) Beginning with the 2026-2027 school year, a school must implement a wearable panic alert system at each school facility. Each wearable panic alert system must be capable of integrating with local public safety answering point infrastructure to transmit 911 calls and mobile activations and initiating a campus-wide lockdown notification.

(b) Each school must provide each staff person in a school facility with a wearable panic alert device that allows for immediate contact with local emergency response agencies.

Subd. 4.

Training.

Prior to the first day of school each year, each school must ensure that all school facility personnel receive training on the protocol for and appropriate use of the panic alert device.

Subd. 5.

Security information.

(a) Each school must ensure that all security information within a school facility, including camera, map, and access control information, is accessible by a local law enforcement agency to the extent authorized under chapter 13.

(b) Each school must coordinate with the local law enforcement agency to establish appropriate access protocols for security information.

(c) Each school must retain ownership of security information or other information generated by the panic alert system under this section.

Sec. 2. APPROPRIATIONS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the Department of Education for the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

Panic alert systems.

(a) To reimburse schools for the cost of implementing panic alert system requirements under Minnesota Statutes, section 121A.09:

2027

(b) The commissioner must reimburse schools in the form and manner determined by the commissioner.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2028.
